tools.name: studio_list
tools.description: List the Roblox Studio windows currently connected to the bridge plugin.

tools.name: bridge_update
tools.description: Check for a newer Studio Bridge release. Without confirm it only reports. With confirm true it downloads the release, verifies its checksum and installs it; the user must then run /mcp. Set confirm only after the user has agreed to the update.

confirm.description: Set true only after the user agreed to install the update.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture the Roblox Studio window as an image (brings the window to the front first). Pass "studio" to choose the window by place name when several Studio windows are open.

studio.description: Place name fragment (or other selector) to choose the Studio window.

max_width.description: Downscale to this width in pixels (default 1280, 0 keeps full size).

tools.name: asset_upload
tools.description: Upload a local file to Roblox through Open Cloud (animations as .rbxm exported with export_rbxm, models, images, audio, meshes). Needs an API key in ~/.roblox-key.txt or ROBLOX_API_KEY. Uploads run one at a time; the same file is refused for 24 hours unless force is true. If it does not finish within wait_seconds you get an operation id: poll it with asset_status and NEVER upload again (a repeat creates a duplicate asset).

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for processing (default 20, max 180).

force.description: Upload even if the identical file was uploaded in the last 24 hours.

tools.name: asset_audit
tools.description: Find every asset id a game references (mesh, texture, sound, animation and other asset properties, string attributes, and ids written in script source) in the open Studio place, then look up who owns each one and report which are yours, Roblox's, someone else's, or unavailable. Open the .rbxl in Studio first (File > Open from File). Owner lookups are keyless and cached; big games may need a second call, passing the scan_file from the first. Results go to a report file.

own_group_id.description: Your group id (assets owned by it count as yours).

studio.description: Which Studio window (the edit window by default).

root.description: Only scan under this path (default the whole game).

include_weak.description: Also report bare long numbers inside scripts that might be asset ids (noisy).

scan_file.description: Skip scanning and reuse a scan file from an earlier call (to continue lookups).

time_budget_seconds.description: How long to spend on owner lookups per call (default 100, max 600).

tools.name: import_rbxm
tools.description: Load a .rbxm or .rbxmx file from this computer (for example one saved by export_rbxm in another place) into the open Studio place. The contents are first unpacked into a hidden holder and scanned for risky script code; if anything high-risk is found nothing is imported unless block_high is false. Use scan_only to just inspect a file. Max 12 MB. Use this to move models, rigs and animations between places.

file.description: Full path to the .rbxm or .rbxmx file.

parent.description: Where to put the contents, e.g. game.Workspace.

scan_only.description: Only list the contents and the scan result; import nothing.

block_high.description: Refuse to import when high-risk code is found (default true).

studio.description: Which Studio window (the edit window by default).

tools.name: asset_upload_batch
tools.description: Upload many local files to Roblox through Open Cloud, one at a time, without waiting on each, then check them all in one polling pass. Results (label, display name, operation id, asset id, errors) go to a JSON results file instead of the conversation. Identical files already uploaded in the last 24 hours are reused, so re-running a batch after an interruption resumes instead of duplicating. If some are still processing when it returns, finish checking with asset_batch_status and NEVER upload them again.

label.description: Your own key for this item (shown in results).

description.description: Default description for items without their own.

wait_seconds.description: How long to poll for processing afterwards (default 60, max 600).

force.description: Upload even identical files uploaded in the last 24 hours.

tools.name: asset_batch_status
tools.description: Finish checking a batch: re-polls every unfinished item of a results file written by asset_upload_batch or asset_publish_instances, updates the file, and summarizes it. Never uploads anything.

results_file.description: Path of the results JSON file.

wait_seconds.description: How long to keep polling (default 30, max 600).

tools.name: asset_publish_instances
tools.description: Export instances from Studio (for example KeyframeSequences from a rig's AnimSaves folder) as separate .rbxm files and upload them all to Roblox. Each asset is named "{instance name} {suffix}" (put the rig name in suffix so it comes last). Results go to a results file; see asset_batch_status for unfinished items. Needs the same key and creator settings as asset_upload_batch.

paths.description: Instance paths to publish, each as its own asset.

parent.description: Alternative to paths: publish every child of this instance of the given class.

class.description: With parent: only children of this class (default KeyframeSequence).

suffix.description: Added after the name, e.g. the rig name.

studio.description: Which Studio window (the edit window by default).

tools.name: asset_key_check
tools.description: Check that an Open Cloud API key is set up (in ~/.roblox-key.txt or ROBLOX_API_KEY) and accepted by Roblox, without printing it or uploading anything. Run this before the first upload.

tools.name: asset_status
tools.description: Check an Open Cloud upload by operation id (returns the asset id when done, plus the moderation state).

tools.name: run_luau
tools.description: Run Luau code inside a connected Roblox Studio window (plugin context). print/warn output and returned values come back. Changes are grouped into one undo step. Windows: the edit window (default), "server" (the running game server during a play session), and "client" (the player client, reached through a relay). If several windows are connected, pass "studio" (id prefix, placeId, part of the place name, or the role).

studio.description: Which Studio window: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: script_get
tools.description: Read a script's source with line numbers, optionally a line range. Paths look like game.Workspace.Model["Name With Spaces"].Part.

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: script_set
tools.description: Replace the whole source of an existing script. Reports a syntax error if the new source does not compile.

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: script_edit
tools.description: Apply line edits to a script. All line numbers refer to the script as it is BEFORE the edits, so several edits in one call never drift. ops: replace (start_line, end_line, text), delete (start_line, end_line), insert (after_line, text; after_line 0 inserts at the top).

text.description: New text for replace/insert (may be multi-line).

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: script_search
tools.description: Search script sources (default whole game) for text. Returns script paths with matching line numbers.

plain.description: Plain text match (default true). False uses a Lua pattern.

context_lines.description: Lines of context around each match.

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: script_validate
tools.description: Check Luau syntax of a script (by path) or of a source string, without running it.

source.description: Source to check instead of a path.

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: instance_find
tools.description: Find instances under a root by name (substring, or * and ? wildcards), class, tag or property value.

exact.description: Require the whole name to match.

class.description: Class name; subclasses match unless exact_class.

value.description: Value for property. Values: plain string/number/boolean, or typed objects such as {"Vector3":[x,y,z]}, {"Vector2":[x,y]}, {"Color3":[r,g,b]} (0-255), {"CFrame":[12 numbers]}, {"UDim2":[xs,xo,ys,yo]}, {"UDim":[s,o]}, {"Enum":"Enum.Material.Plastic"}, {"BrickColor":"Bright red"}, {"NumberRange":[min,max]}, {"Instance":"game.Workspace.Part"}, {"Number":"inf"}.

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: instance_children
tools.description: List children of an instance, optionally as a tree. Paths look like game.Workspace.Model["Name With Spaces"].Part.

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: instance_get
tools.description: Get properties, attributes, tags and child count of an instance. Without "properties" every readable property is returned (Source omitted). Values: plain string/number/boolean, or typed objects such as {"Vector3":[x,y,z]}, {"Vector2":[x,y]}, {"Color3":[r,g,b]} (0-255), {"CFrame":[12 numbers]}, {"UDim2":[xs,xo,ys,yo]}, {"UDim":[s,o]}, {"Enum":"Enum.Material.Plastic"}, {"BrickColor":"Bright red"}, {"NumberRange":[min,max]}, {"Instance":"game.Workspace.Part"}, {"Number":"inf"}.

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: instance_set
tools.description: Set properties, attributes and tags on one or many instances. Values: plain string/number/boolean, or typed objects such as {"Vector3":[x,y,z]}, {"Vector2":[x,y]}, {"Color3":[r,g,b]} (0-255), {"CFrame":[12 numbers]}, {"UDim2":[xs,xo,ys,yo]}, {"UDim":[s,o]}, {"Enum":"Enum.Material.Plastic"}, {"BrickColor":"Bright red"}, {"NumberRange":[min,max]}, {"Instance":"game.Workspace.Part"}, {"Number":"inf"}.

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: instance_create
tools.description: Create instances of a class under a parent. Values: plain string/number/boolean, or typed objects such as {"Vector3":[x,y,z]}, {"Vector2":[x,y]}, {"Color3":[r,g,b]} (0-255), {"CFrame":[12 numbers]}, {"UDim2":[xs,xo,ys,yo]}, {"UDim":[s,o]}, {"Enum":"Enum.Material.Plastic"}, {"BrickColor":"Bright red"}, {"NumberRange":[min,max]}, {"Instance":"game.Workspace.Part"}, {"Number":"inf"}.

class.description: Class name, e.g. Part, Folder, Script.

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: camera_set
tools.description: Move the Studio editor camera (not the player camera). The first move remembers the original view; call again with restore true to put it back.

target.description: [x, y, z] point to look at.

restore.description: Restore the view saved before the first camera change.

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: camera_frame
tools.description: Point the Studio editor camera at instances so they fill the view, from a chosen angle. The first move remembers the original view (camera_set with restore true brings it back). Paths look like game.Workspace.Model["Name With Spaces"].Part.

paths.description: Instances (models, parts or folders of parts) to frame.

yaw.description: Horizontal angle in degrees around the object (default 35).

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: viewport_screenshot
tools.description: Capture only the 3D viewport of Studio (no panels) as an image. With frame_paths it first frames those instances from the given angle, takes the picture, then restores your camera (unless restore is false). Works without focusing the window.

max_width.description: Downscale to this width (default 1000, 0 keeps the full size).

frame_paths.description: Optional: frame these instances before capturing.

restore.description: Restore the camera after framing (default true).

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: selection_get
tools.description: List what is currently selected in Studio (use it when the user says "this" or "the selected one").

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: selection_set
tools.description: Select instances in Studio so the user can see them (an empty list clears the selection). Paths look like game.Workspace.Model["Name With Spaces"].Part.

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: export_rbxm
tools.description: Serialize instances (for example a KeyframeSequence or a model) to a binary .rbxm file saved on this computer. The reply gives the saved path; pass it to asset_upload. Paths look like game.Workspace.Model["Name With Spaces"].Part.

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: script_scan
tools.description: Scan scripts for risky code: require by asset id, loadstring, LoadAsset, getfenv/setfenv, obfuscated strings, HTTP calls, teleports, kicks, DataStore access. Findings are ranked high, medium, low with path and line. Use it on any model taken from the Creator Store or another place before trusting it. Paths look like game.Workspace.Model["Name With Spaces"].Part.

root.description: Scan under this path (default the whole place).

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: logs_get
tools.description: Read the Output log of a Studio window. In a play session pass studio "server" or "client" to read that side (use studio_list to see which windows exist).

types.description: Only these types: output, info, warning, error.

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: ui_build
tools.description: Build a whole GUI (or any instance tree) from one nested description. A node is {"class": "Frame", "name": "Menu", "properties": {...}, "attributes": {...}, "tags": [...], "source": "...", "children": [nodes]}. Values: plain string/number/boolean, or typed objects such as {"Vector3":[x,y,z]}, {"Vector2":[x,y]}, {"Color3":[r,g,b]} (0-255), {"CFrame":[12 numbers]}, {"UDim2":[xs,xo,ys,yo]}, {"UDim":[s,o]}, {"Enum":"Enum.Material.Plastic"}, {"BrickColor":"Bright red"}, {"NumberRange":[min,max]}, {"Instance":"game.Workspace.Part"}, {"Number":"inf"}. Example: {"class":"ScreenGui","name":"Menu","children":[{"class":"Frame","properties":{"Size":{"UDim2":[0,300,0,200]},"BackgroundColor3":{"Color3":[30,30,40]}},"children":[{"class":"UICorner","properties":{"CornerRadius":{"UDim":[0,8]}}}]}]}. Paths look like game.Workspace.Model["Name With Spaces"].Part.

parent.description: Where to build it, e.g. game.StarterGui.

tree.description: The root node of the tree.

replace.description: Delete an existing sibling with the same name as the root first.

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: ui_check
tools.description: Check the on-screen GUI of a running play session for layout problems: off-screen or clipped elements, overlapping buttons and text, text that does not fit, small text, small touch targets, zero-size elements and low text contrast. Runs in the player client automatically, at the current viewport size (so start a play session first).

root.description: Only check under this path (default the whole PlayerGui).

min_touch_size.description: Smallest allowed button size in pixels (default 40).

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: gui_snapshot
tools.description: List the on-screen GUI of the player in a running play session (runs in the client window automatically): path, class, text, whether it is a button or input, and its center and size in screen pixels. Use it to find what to click.

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: gui_click
tools.description: Click a GUI object (by path) or a screen position in the player client of a running play session, using virtual input.

path.description: GUI object path; its center is clicked.

x.description: Screen x when no path is given.

y.description: Screen y when no path is given.

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: play_start
tools.description: Start a play session from the edit window. mode "play" is Play Solo (server plus client); "run" is Run mode. Warning: the game runs for real, so scripts that touch live services (DataStores with API access on, HTTP) can have real effects.

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: run_test
tools.description: Run a test in a fresh play session and return the result. Your Luau runs inside a temporary server script (deleted afterwards) with a "test" table: test.signal(name, data) records a named result, test.fail(message) fails the test. An error fails the test, a normal finish passes it, the return value is reported, task.wait is allowed. Returns PASS/FAIL, duration, error, signals and the log lines produced during the session. The game runs for real, so scripts that touch live services have real effects.

mode.description: Default play (server plus a client character).

timeout_seconds.description: Fail the test after this long (default 60, max 300).

log_lines.description: How many trailing log lines to include (default 40).

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: play_stop
tools.description: Stop the running play session (targets the server window automatically).

result.description: Optional text recorded as the test result.

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: instance_delete
tools.description: Delete instances (services and top-level children of game are refused).

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: instance_move
tools.description: Reparent instances.

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: instance_clone
tools.description: Clone an instance.

parent.description: Parent for the clone (default same parent).

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: batch
tools.description: Run several edit-window tools in one call and one undo step. Results come back numbered in order. Use it for read-then-edit sequences instead of separate calls. Not for playtests, GUI testing, screenshots or uploads.

operations.description: Up to 50 operations, run in order.

stop_on_error.description: Stop at the first failing operation (default true).

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected.

timeout_seconds.description: Max seconds for the whole batch (default 60, max 600).

tools.name: tag_manage
tools.description: CollectionService tags. list: every tag in use with its count. find: instances with a tag. get: the tags on instances. add / remove: change tags on instances.

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: raycast
tools.description: Cast one ray, or several with rays, through the place. Give an origin and either a target point or a direction (its length is the distance). Reports what was hit, where, the surface normal and the material.

maxDistance.description: Rescale the ray to this length.

rays.description: Several rays, each with origin and target or direction (and optionally maxDistance), instead of the single-ray fields.

only.description: Only hit these instances (and their descendants).

respectCanCollide.description: Skip parts whose CanCollide is off (default false).

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: spatial_query
tools.description: Find what is near a point or inside a box, nearest first, or measure the world bounds of an instance. mode radius: parts within radius of center. mode box: parts in a box at center with size and optional yaw degrees. mode bounds: center, size, min and max of path. group collapses parts into their outermost model.

yaw.description: Box rotation around Y in degrees (box).

class.description: Only things that are this class (IsA).

group.description: Report the outermost model instead of each part.

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: scatter
tools.description: Scatter copies of a model or part across an area, dropped onto whatever ground is below, into a new folder. Handles slope alignment, random spin and scale, minimum spacing and a seed for repeatable results.

parent.description: Where the new folder goes (default Workspace).

center.description: Area center [x, y, z]; rays start above this height.

minSpacing.description: Minimum distance between copies in studs.

align.description: Tilt to the ground normal (default true).

randomYaw.description: Random spin around the up axis (default true).

offsetY.description: Lift above the ground in studs.

rayHeight.description: How far above and below center to look for ground (default 200).

ignore.description: Extra instances to ignore when finding ground.

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: terrain
tools.description: Edit terrain. fill: a block, ball or cylinder of a material. clear: a region, or everything with all: true. read: which materials fill a region. generate: procedural noise terrain over an area with a biome (grassland, desert, snow, volcanic, tropical), height, optional water level and a seed; it overwrites the area.

material.description: Enum.Material name for fill, such as Grass, Sand, Rock, Water.

size.description: Block or region size [x, y, z] for fill, clear and read; [width, depth] for generate.

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees [x, y, z] for block and cylinder.

all.description: clear every voxel in the place.

amplitude.description: Hill height in studs for generate (default 40).

scale.description: Feature size in studs for generate (default 120).

seed.description: Noise seed for generate; reported back so it can be repeated.

waterLevel.description: Fill water up to this Y for generate.

depth.description: How far below center the ground goes for generate (default 16).

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: environment
tools.description: Lighting and atmosphere. list: the presets (day, sunset, night, overcast, foggy, horror, space). get: current Lighting, Atmosphere, Bloom, ColorCorrection, SunRays and DepthOfField values. apply: a preset and/or per-section property overrides; missing effects are created.

lighting.description: Lighting properties to set, for example {"ClockTime": 17}.

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: tween_play
tools.description: Preview a tween on an instance in the edit window. By default it waits for the tween to finish and then restores the original values, so it leaves the place unchanged; pass restore: false to keep the end state.

properties.description: Goal values by property name, for example {"Position": {"Vector3": [0, 10, 0]}}.

wait.description: Wait for it to finish (default true).

restore.description: Put the original values back afterwards (default true when waiting).

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: physics_report
tools.description: Scan parts for physics problems: loose unanchored parts, parts below the void, oversized or tiny parts, invisible collidable parts and MeshParts without a mesh. Reports counts with sample paths.

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: audio_report
tools.description: Scan Sound instances: missing SoundId, volume 0 or above 5, sounds set to Playing, and SoundIds used more than once.

root.description: Where to scan (default the whole place).

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: animation_inspect
tools.description: Describe a KeyframeSequence (length, loop, priority, joints, markers, keyframe times, and with detail every pose as position, rotation in degrees, weight and easing), or list every KeyframeSequence and count Animation instances under a container.

path.description: A KeyframeSequence, or a container to list.

detail.description: Include every pose of every keyframe.

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: animation_create
tools.description: Build a KeyframeSequence from a description. Give the rig so the poses are nested to match its Motor6D joints, then keyframes with a time and poses keyed by part name (position in studs, rotation in degrees as an offset from the rest pose). Intermediate joints are added automatically.

rig.description: The rig model the animation is for.

poses.description: Poses by part name, for example {"RightUpperArm": {"rotation": [0, 0, 45]}}.

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: animation_edit
tools.description: Edit a KeyframeSequence with a list of operations: scale_time {factor}, shift_time {seconds}, reverse, delete_keyframes {times or from and to}, add_marker {time, name, value}, set {loop, priority, name}. Pass copyName to edit a copy and leave the original alone.

copyName.description: Clone the sequence under this name and edit the clone.

copyParent.description: Where to put the clone (default beside the original).

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: animation_pose
tools.description: Pose a rig from a KeyframeSequence at a time (interpolating between keyframes) by setting its Motor6D transforms, so you can take a screenshot of the result; or reset the rig to its rest pose. The pose is not saved with the place.

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: animation_ids
tools.description: Animation instances and their AnimationIds. list: every Animation with its id. set: give one Animation an id. remap: replace ids across the place using a map of old id to new id (for example after re-uploading animations); dryRun shows what would change.

root.description: Where to look (default the whole place).

map.description: Old id to new id, for example {"111": "222"} (remap).

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.

tools.name: audio_manage
tools.description: Sounds in the place. list: sounds with id, volume, speed, looping, rolloff and group. create: a Sound with an asset id and properties. set: change properties, scale the volume or assign a SoundGroup on many sounds (by paths, or by root and a name filter). group: create a SoundGroup and optionally assign sounds to it. effect: add a reverb, echo, equalizer or other SoundEffect to a Sound or SoundGroup. remap: replace SoundIds using a map of old id to new id (dryRun to preview).

root.description: Where to look (default the whole place).

nameContains.description: Only sounds whose name contains this.

parent.description: Parent for create (required) or group (default SoundService).

properties.description: Properties to set, using the same value forms as instance_set.

volumeScale.description: Multiply the volume of each sound (set).

path.description: The Sound or SoundGroup to add an effect to.

studio.description: Which Studio window when several are connected: id prefix, placeId, or place name fragment.
